description: RbNaTiO₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Rb is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent O atoms. There are two shorter (2.87 Å) and two longer (2.99 Å) Rb-O bond lengths. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.36-2.40 Å. Ti is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted edge-sharing TiO₅ trigonal bipyramids. There are a spread of Ti-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-2.00 Å. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Ti atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Rb, one Na, and one Ti atom.
